title: Patient Financial Assistance Program Account Terms: Refunds, Collections Recall, Review Holds, Reversals and Rescission
content:
The Patient Financial Assistance Program fixes, for every tier, how payments already made are treated, what happens to invoices in collections and while a case is pending, and when a discount granted may be reversed or an award rescinded.

## Refunds and the treatment of invoices

| Tier | Payments already made above the discounted amount on a covered invoice refunded | Smallest refund issued (smaller amounts stay as a credit on the invoice) | Refund issued within, calendar days after the discount is applied | Covered invoices in collections recalled on approval | Eligible open invoices put on hold while the case is pending |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Financial Assistance 25% Discount | No (the discount is limited to the balance still due) | $5.00 | 30 | Yes | Yes |
| Financial Assistance 50% Discount | No (the discount is limited to the balance still due) | $5.00 | 30 | Yes | Yes |
| Financial Assistance 75% Discount | Yes | $5.00 | 30 | Yes | Yes |
| Financial Assistance Full Discount | Yes | $5.00 | 30 | Yes | Yes |
| Presumptive Eligibility Full Discount | Yes | $5.00 | 30 | Yes | Yes |
| Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment | No (the discount is limited to the balance still due) | $5.00 | 30 | Yes | Yes |

## Reversal and rescission

| Tier | Discount reversed to the extent a payer later pays the same invoice | Award may be rescinded on a misrepresentation finding | Months before the rescission date whose discounts are reversed on rescission, calendar months |
|---|---|---|---|
| Financial Assistance 25% Discount | Yes | Yes | 12 |
| Financial Assistance 50% Discount | Yes | Yes | 12 |
| Financial Assistance 75% Discount | Yes | Yes | 12 |
| Financial Assistance Full Discount | Yes | Yes | 12 |
| Presumptive Eligibility Full Discount | Yes | Yes | 12 |
| Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment | Yes | Yes | 12 |

## Reading the refund terms

- Payments already made above the discounted amount are refunded under the Financial Assistance 75% Discount, the Financial Assistance Full Discount and the Presumptive Eligibility Full Discount. Under the Financial Assistance 25% Discount, the Financial Assistance 50% Discount and the Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment they are not, and the discount is limited to the balance still due.
- **Illustration (hypothetical amounts).** A credit of $4.80 is below the $5.00 smallest refund and stays as a credit on the invoice; a credit of $5.00 is refunded, within 30 calendar days after the discount is applied.
